name: an excluded random option's key weight is asked, but its number is neither checked nor counted
because: the guard and the key weight are asked in one request, since whether the random option is in play is not known until both are answered; a game may work out a number no weight can have for a random option its guard rules out, so once the world withholds Guard.IsAngry the -10 is never read, and the run draws with the auto weight taking all of 100 where a port that checked it would refuse it as an invalid weight
